The members of the IDC believe that the offer is fair and reasonable and in line with the SEBI (SAST) Regulations. However, the Public Shareholders of the Target Company are advised to independently evaluate the Open Offer and make an informed decision about whether or not to tender their shares in the Open Offer. The maximum applicable interest will be INR 2.68 (Indian Rupees Two and sixty eight paise only) per Equity Shares. Further, the members of the IDC draw attention to the closing market price of the Equity Shares of the Target Company on NSE as on October 27, 2026 being Rs. 340.75 per Equity Share, which is lower than the Offer Price. The Public Shareholders of the Target Company are advised to independently evaluate the Open Offer and make an informed decision on whether or not to tender their shares in the Open Offer.
